content: Scopus SDG mapping (2023 methodology): matches Title/Abstract/Author-Keywords/Indexed-Terms/Subject-Areas against per-SDG keyword queries built by Elsevier data science + ML predictive element, for high precision; not a raw 0-1 weight/relevance score exposed simply as a field — it's a label-assignment/query-match approach (Scopus-SM), distinct from Aurora/BERT-based ML approaches used by other providers. >25M Scopus records have at least one 2023 SDG label. THE Impact Rankings use this mapping. This suggests the project's assumed 'float weight 0.0-1.0 per SDG' field may not directly exist in Scopus API responses as described — needs verification against actual API field (flagged already as Open Question in SPEC.md).
